skills.empathy: Recognises and names the customer's feelings and responds with care.
skills.active_listening: Lets the customer speak, asks targeted questions, reformulates.
skills.de_escalation: Lowers tension and keeps control of an angry or pressing customer.
skills.accuracy: Gives correct, verified information and figures.
skills.procedure_compliance: Follows the mandatory steps (identity check, ticket, scripts).
skills.resolution: Brings the issue to a clear outcome with a next step and a delay.
skills.escalation_handling: Escalates at the right moment, to the right team, with a clean handover.

intents.title: Double billing
success_criteria: Checks the billing history before answering
Acknowledges that this is a repeated problem
Opens a correction or refund ticket and gives a delay

card.en: You were charged twice for the same invoice. This is the third time you call this month and nobody has fixed it.
card.fr: On vous a facturé deux fois la même facture. C'est la troisième fois que vous appelez ce mois-ci et personne n'a réglé le problème.
card.derja: خلّصت الفاتورة مرتين على نفس الشهر، وهاذي تالت مرة نعيّط فيها هالشهر وحتى واحد ما حلّ المشكل.

intents.title: Roaming bill shock
success_criteria: Reassures the customer before explaining figures
Explains what has been charged and how to stop further charges
Offers a roaming pack or a limit when relevant

card.en: You are travelling abroad and fear a huge data-roaming bill. You want to know what you have been charged and how to stop it.
card.fr: Vous voyagez à l'étranger et vous craignez une énorme facture d'itinérance data. Vous voulez savoir ce qui a été facturé et comment l'arrêter.
card.derja: أنا مسافر برّا وخايف تجيني فاتورة غالية على الإنترنت متاع الروومينغ. نحب نعرف شنوة تخلّص عليّ وكيفاش نوقّفها.

intents.title: Line cut
success_criteria: Verifies identity and the line status
Finds the cause (unpaid invoice, network, SIM) before promising anything
Gives a restoration delay and a way to follow up

card.en: Your line was cut while you are abroad and you cannot make calls any more.
card.fr: Votre ligne a été coupée alors que vous êtes à l'étranger et vous ne pouvez plus appeler.
card.derja: الخط متاعي تقطع وأنا برّا تونس وما عادش نجّم نعيّط.

intents.title: Slow internet
success_criteria: Runs the standard diagnostic steps in order
Explains each step in plain words
Schedules a technician if the diagnostic fails

card.en: Your home internet has been very slow for a week and you can no longer work from home.
card.fr: Votre connexion internet est très lente depuis une semaine et vous ne pouvez plus télétravailler.
card.derja: الإنترنت في الدار بطيئة برشا من أسبوع وما عادش نجّم نخدم.

intents.title: Cancellation request
success_criteria: Explores the reason before offering anything
Offers a relevant retention option without pressure
Respects the decision and explains the cancellation steps if the customer insists

card.en: You want to cancel after six years. You really did not want to, but the prices keep going up.
card.fr: Vous voulez résilier après six ans. Vous n'en avez pas vraiment envie, mais les prix n'arrêtent pas d'augmenter.
card.derja: نحب نلغي الاشتراك بعد ستّ سنين. والله ما حبّيتش نعملها، أما الأسعار ديما تزيد.

intents.title: Refund follow-up
success_criteria: Finds the refund request in the system
Gives a precise status and expected date
Offers a follow-up channel if the date is missed

card.en: You are waiting for a refund promised two weeks ago and want to know where it is.
card.fr: Vous attendez un remboursement promis il y a deux semaines et vous voulez savoir où il en est.
card.derja: استنّيت رجوع الفلوس اللي وعدوني بيه من جوج أسابيع ونحب نعرف وين وصل.

intents.title: Data allowance question
success_criteria: Gives the remaining data and the renewal date correctly
Keeps the answer short and clear
Checks whether the customer needs anything else

card.en: You calmly ask how much data is left on your plan and when it renews.
card.fr: Vous demandez calmement combien de data il vous reste et quand votre forfait se renouvelle.
card.derja: نحب نعرف قدّاش باقي عندي ميغا في الباقة وإمتى تتجدّد.

intents.title: Plan change
success_criteria: Asks about real usage before recommending a plan
States the price and the conditions of the new plan
Confirms the change and its start date

card.en: You want a cheaper plan but you do not want to lose your current number or benefits.
card.fr: Vous voulez un forfait moins cher sans perdre votre numéro ni vos avantages.
card.derja: نحب نبدّل الباقة متاعي بوحدة أرخص أما من غير ما نخسر نمرتي ولا الامتيازات.

intents.title: Unexplained fee
success_criteria: Never calls the fee 'normal' without explaining it
Explains the origin of the fee and where it was disclosed
Offers a gesture or an escalation if the customer's complaint is justified

card.en: You were charged a fee nobody explained to you, and you were told it was 'normal'. You find that insulting.
card.fr: On vous a prélevé des frais que personne ne vous a expliqués, et on vous a dit que c'était « normal ». Vous trouvez cela insultant.
card.derja: خصموا عليّ رسوم ما شرحهالي حتى واحد، وقالولي هاذي عادية. نشوفها إهانة.

intents.title: Lost phone or SIM
success_criteria: Blocks the line quickly after a proper identity check
Explains the replacement SIM steps and delay
Reassures the customer about charges made after the loss

card.en: You lost your phone with your SIM card and want the line blocked immediately and a replacement.
card.fr: Vous avez perdu votre téléphone avec la carte SIM et vous voulez bloquer la ligne tout de suite et obtenir un remplacement.
card.derja: ضاع منّي التليفون بالشريحة وحاب نبلوكي الخط توّا ونطلب وحدة جديدة.

intents.title: Missed installation
success_criteria: Apologises sincerely without blaming the technician team
Gives a new appointment with a time window
Offers compensation if the policy allows it

card.en: A technician was supposed to come on Monday and did not show up. You waited at home all day.
card.fr: Un technicien devait venir lundi et ne s'est pas présenté. Vous avez attendu chez vous toute la journée.
card.derja: الفنّي كان لازم يجي نهار الإثنين وما جاش، وأنا قعدت نستنّى في الدار النهار كامل.

intents.title: Unrecognized charge
success_criteria: Verifies identity before discussing the charge
Identifies the charge from the billing detail
Escalates to the fraud team if the charge is not explained

card.en: There is a charge on your bill you do not recognize and you fear someone used your number.
card.fr: Il y a sur votre facture un prélèvement que vous ne reconnaissez pas et vous craignez que quelqu'un ait utilisé votre numéro.
card.derja: لقيت في الفاتورة خصم ما نعرفوش وخايف يكون حد استعمل نمرتي.

intents.title: Contract renewal offer
success_criteria: Presents offers that match the customer's usage
Does not pressure the customer to decide during the call
Summarises the conditions before closing

card.en: You received a message about renewing your contract and want to know the offers before deciding.
card.fr: Vous avez reçu un message sur le renouvellement de votre contrat et vous voulez connaître les offres avant de décider.
card.derja: جاتني رسالة على تجديد العقد ونحب نعرف شنوّة العروض قبل ما نقرّر.

intents.title: Thank-you call
success_criteria: Receives the thanks warmly and briefly
Answers the small follow-up question correctly
Closes the call positively

card.en: Your refund just arrived and the advisor who handled it was very kind. You call to thank them and to check the date of your next invoice.
card.fr: Votre remboursement vient d'arriver et le conseiller qui s'en est occupé a été très aimable. Vous appelez pour le remercier et vérifier la date de votre prochaine facture.
card.derja: الفلوس رجعوهالي توّا والمستشار اللي تكفّل بيا كان لطيف برشا. عيّطت نشكرو ونتأكّد من تاريخ الفاتورة الجاية.

intents.title: Formal complaint
success_criteria: Listens to the whole story without interrupting
Records the complaint with the mandatory details
Explains the handling process, the delay and the written answer

card.en: You want to file a formal complaint about the way you were treated in a shop and you want a written answer.
card.fr: Vous voulez déposer une réclamation formelle sur la façon dont vous avez été reçu en boutique et vous exigez une réponse écrite.
card.derja: نحب نقدّم شكاية رسمية على كيفاش عاملوني في الفرع وحاب جواب مكتوب.

events.text: The customer interrupts the advisor and talks over explanations.
events.expect: Stays calm, lets the customer finish, then summarises.

events.text: The customer describes the problem vaguely and needs guiding questions.
events.expect: Asks targeted questions instead of guessing.

events.text: Midway through the call, the customer raises a second, unrelated problem.
events.expect: Brings the first issue to closure, then logs and handles the second.

events.text: The customer demands to speak to a supervisor.
events.expect: Follows the escalation rules without being defensive.

events.text: The customer threatens to switch to a competitor.
events.expect: Acknowledges the feeling and offers real options without over-promising.

events.text: A previous advisor gave the customer wrong information.
events.expect: Corrects the information politely and takes ownership.

events.text: The real reason for the call is not stated at first.
The customer has already called about this several times.
events.expect: Reads the history and does not ask for everything again.

events.text: The customer is in a hurry and has only a few minutes.
events.expect: Prioritises the fix and keeps the call short.

events.text: The customer gives details that contradict each other.
events.expect: Clarifies politely and verifies before acting.

events.text: The line is poor and the customer is hard to hear.
events.expect: Confirms understanding and repeats the key details.

events.text: A network outage is affecting many customers at the same time.
events.expect: Gives honest information and follows the incident procedure.

events.text: Signs suggest that the account may be compromised or that the caller is not the account holder.
events.expect: Applies identity verification and the security procedure.

events.text: The customer is calling about the account of a relative who has just died.
events.expect: Shows sensitivity and follows the bereavement procedure.
Stays factual, does not admit liability and escalates per procedure.

events.text: The customer threatens to post about the problem publicly.
events.expect: De-escalates and involves the right team if needed.

events.text: The customer has a hearing or visual impairment and needs another way to communicate.
events.expect: Adapts the communication and checks understanding.
